build.command: make -C /work/build/client -j2 libp50zstdsender.a && make -C /work/build/cache -j2 libp50endpoint.a libp50adoptedoutcomewriter.a libprotocol50.a && make -C /work/build/services -j2 libicecc.la && make -C /work/build/unittests -j2 p50transferwindowbench

input.provenance_note: Quietbox2 corpus2 input-index paths identify CMakeFiles RocksDB test targets and .cc source paths; its README calls this first-50 RocksDB staging. Exact upstream source revision and preprocessing build command are not recorded; do not claim reproducible upstream version or representative project coverage.

execution.order: rep1 ascending cells; rep2 reverse cell order; rep3 ascending cells

semantics.fresh_retained: Fresh = first measured pass on newly created sender/route state; retained = second pass reusing that route state and identical ordered inputs. These are not OS page-cache cold/hot states and are not an edited-pair comparison.
semantics.latency: R1 latency is sequential per-transfer call time. R2 latency is concurrent submission-to-matching-receipt time. Do not compare their latency percentiles as equivalent quantities.
semantics.verification: Each invocation required exact decoded input/output identity. raw_decoded_bytes_verified equals 342976618 (two passes of 171488309). R2 exact CacheWire counters are cross-checked against F socket byte totals.
semantics.occupancy: Actual observed peak is recorded independently of requested window; W16 peaked 5–15 and W30 peaked 10–11, so these runs do not demonstrate full W16/W30 saturation.

prior_unqualified_run.reason: The first 21-run batch used an older client/libp50zstdsender.a; archive timestamp was older than source changes. It is retained only as build-closure diagnostic evidence.

host.competing_host_activity: At start, unrelated python3 /repo/jobs/backup_coverage.py used ~33.6% CPU. No known competing timed benchmark overlapped; results are not isolated-host throughput claims.
